note: Campground in the Boardman Creek arm of Merritt Reservoir SRA, ~26 mi SW of Valentine in the Sandhills. Grassy sites. The park's shower building is at Cedar Bay; the dump station is across from the Fisherman's Boat Ramp, southeast of the dam. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica park page and all 14 Boardman Creek site pages read: 10 Electric Plus (50 A, no water or sewer) and 4 Basic, all back-in, 34-78 ft; open year round; 180-day window; 74 of Merritt's 161 sites book online. Hookups, sites, season and booking written; platform operator -> reserveamerica. Fees and facilities left. Pin OK. Waterfront: lakeview suggested over not waterfront (site photo). Sand-surfaced pads flagged for the sand rule.
flags: WATER (upgrade suggested, not waterfront -> lakeview): RA tags sites 009, 010 and 011 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'. The official site-011 photo shows the open lake past the campground's gravel loop road, so the road rules out on-water. 3DEP puts 009-011 at 898-899.5 m against a ~897.7 m water surface, ~40-50 m from the shore through scattered trees and a reed edge. The other 11 sites are up the slope along the entry road.

SAND RULE (question for AWH, not a drop as I read it): RA gives 'Driveway Surface: Sand' for all 14 Boardman Creek sites, as it does for Cedar Bay, Willow Cove and most of Beed's Landing. These are numbered pads in a developed loop with electric pedestals, not beach or shoreline camping, and the official photos show a packed sand-gravel pad and loop road. Raising it because EKKO is 2WD.
PIN OK: stored 42.58015,-100.88696 is ~220 m from the centroid of RA's 14 site points (42.58087,-100.88949), 106 m from site 001.

SPLIT/MISSING CAMPGROUNDS at Merritt (8 campgrounds; only Boardman 2716 and Cedar Bay 2717 are entries): Willow Cove Campground (9 reservable Electric Plus sites, 50 A, 40-60 ft, all RA-tagged Lakefront; centroid 42.62142,-100.86577, ~2.9 km NE of Cedar Bay and ~1 km S of the dam) is a separate place with its own spur. It is a split/new-entry candidate. Beed's Landing (26 reservable sites: 24 Electric Plus, 2 Basic; centroid 42.59329,-100.89326) is only ~500 m from Cedar Bay, so it is not a split under the ~1 km rule; see 2717. The park's other campgrounds (Powder Horn, Snake River, etc.) are not on RA and I did not locate them.
